description: The plot illustrates how a measured score (y-values) changes as the “Number of Tokens” increases for four source types: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 200 to 1000 with labeled ticks at 200, 400, 600, and 800 (the rightmost endpoint at 1000 is shown by the final points but not labeled as a tick). The y-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and shows tick labels at 10-unit intervals (10, 20, 30, 40), with values extending into the mid-40s. The Tutorials series is a blue solid line with circular markers, rising from about 24 at 200 tokens to about 34 at 400, about 41 at 800, and about 44 at 1000. The Library Documentation series is a red solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 27 at 200 to about 36 at 400, reaching about 44 at 800, then slightly decreasing to about 43 at 1000. The StackOverflow posts series is a yellow solid line with circular markers, starting around 33 at 200, increasing to about 37 at 400, then declining to about 31 at 800 and about 28 at 1000. The Github files series is a green solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 29 at 200 to about 37 at 400, to about 44 at 800, and then slightly increasing to about 45 at 1000.
